nodes.description: mapping(bytes32 => uint) public prices; official price per symbolHash written by refresh/postPriceInternal.
mapping(bytes32 => Observation) oldObservations; lagging TWAP window accumulator.
mapping(bytes32 => Observation) newObservations; most recent TWAP window accumulator.
immutable anchorPeriod; minimum seconds before the old accumulator is replaced.
immutable numTokens; number of configured tokens.
constant ethBaseUnit = 1e18 scaling factor for ETH denominated prices.
constant usdtBaseUnit = 1e6 scaling factor for USDT denominated prices.
constant expScale = 1e18 precision scaling factor.
constant ethHash = keccak256('ETH'); sentinel symbol hash for the ETH price.
constant projectHash = keccak256('ZILD'); project identifier.
constant maxTokens = 20; hard cap on number of supported tokens.
Aggregated immutable per-token config storage: gToken00..19, underlying00..19, symbolHash00..19, baseUnit00..19, priceSource00..19, fixedPrice00..19, uniswapMarket00..19, isPrice1FromUniswap00..19.
UniswapConfig constructor; validates gTokens_.length <= maxTokens and copies the 20 token configs into immutable storage via get().
internal pure get(TokenConfig[] memory configs, uint i); bounds-checked array access returning an empty config when out of range.
internal view getCTokenIndex(address gToken); linear scan of gToken00..19, returns uint(-1) when not found.
internal view getUnderlyingIndex(address underlying); linear scan of underlying00..19, returns uint(-1) when not found.
internal view getSymbolHashIndex(bytes32 symbolHash); linear scan of symbolHash00..19, returns uint(-1) when not found.
public view getTokenConfig(uint i); requires i < numTokens and returns the stored TokenConfig.
public view getTokenConfigBySymbol(string symbol); hashes symbol and forwards to getTokenConfigBySymbolHash.
public view getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(bytes32); resolves the index and returns the config or reverts.
public view getTokenConfigByCToken(address gToken); falls back to an external CErc20(gToken).underlying() call for unknown gTokens.
public view getTokenConfigByUnderlying(address underlying); resolves underlying index or reverts.
library function fraction(uint112 numerator, uint112 denominator); returns uq112x112((uint224(numerator) << 112) / denominator).
library function decode112with18(uq112x112 self); returns uint(self._x) / 5192296858534827.
library function currentBlockTimestamp(); returns uint32(block.timestamp % 2**32).
library function currentCumulativePrices(address pair); reads pair reserves and cumulative price counters and adds a counterfactual accumulator delta.
UniswapPriceOracleV2 constructor; sets anchorPeriod, validates baseUnit/priceSource/uniswapMarket and seeds old/new observations.
external view price(string symbol); returns the stored/fixed price through priceInternal.
internal view priceInternal(TokenConfig config); returns prices[symbolHash] for reporters, fixedPrice for FIXED_USD, otherwise 0.
external view getUnderlyingPrice(address gToken); Compound price feed scaling of priceInternal by 1e30/baseUnit.
external refresh(string[] symbols); permissionless entrypoint that fetches the ETH price and reposts every listed symbol.
internal postPriceInternal(string symbol, uint ethPrice); computes an anchor price and writes prices[symbolHash].
internal view currentCumulativePrice(TokenConfig config); selects price0/price1 cumulative from the uniswap market.
internal fetchEthPrice(); returns the ETH/USD anchor price via fetchAnchorPriceUSD('ETH', ...).
internal virtual fetchAnchorPriceETH(string symbol, TokenConfig config, uint ethPrice); TWAP based TOKEN/ETH anchor price computation.
internal virtual fetchAnchorPriceUSD(string symbol, TokenConfig config); TWAP based TOKEN/USD (stablecoin pair) anchor price computation.
internal pokeWindowValues(TokenConfig config); rolls the old/new observation windows when anchorPeriod elapsed and returns TWAP inputs.
public pure source(bytes message, bytes signature); abi.decodes a raw signature and ecrecovers the signer.
internal pure mul(uint a, uint b); overflow-proof multiplication used for all price scaling.
external view getMarketPrice(string symbol); spot market price view combining reserve ratios and ETH price.
internal view virtual fetchMarketPriceByEthPair(TokenConfig, uint ethPrice); spot price from a TOKEN/WETH pair's reserves.
internal view virtual fetchMarketPriceByUsdtPair(TokenConfig); spot price from a TOKEN/USDT pair's reserves.
block.timestamp used for TWAP windows, timeElapsed and observation seeding.
ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) on a caller supplied signature in source().
CErc20(gToken).underlying() external call to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
IUniswapV2Pair(pair).price0CumulativeLast()/price1CumulativeLast() external staticcalls.
IUniswapV2Pair(pair).getReserves() external staticcall inside currentCumulativePrices.
IUniswapV2Pair(config.uniswapMarket).getReserves() external staticcall inside fetchMarketPriceByEthPair.
IUniswapV2Pair(config.uniswapMarket).getReserves() external staticcall inside fetchMarketPriceByUsdtPair.
(uint224(numerator) << 112) / denominator left shift and division inside FixedPoint.fraction.
uint c = a * b; require(c / a == b) manual overflow guard in mul().
price0Cumulative/price1Cumulative += fraction(...) * timeElapsed; deliberate wrapping accumulator addition and uint32 underflow.
return uint(-1) sentinel after the linear index scans (getCTokenIndex/getUnderlyingIndex/getSymbolHashIndex).
abi.decode(signature, (bytes32,bytes32,uint8)) on caller supplied bytes in source().
(nowCumulativePrice - oldCumulativePrice) / timeElapsed TWAP division and uint224 truncation.

edges.reason: refresh() first calls fetchEthPrice() to obtain the ETH anchor price.
refresh() is externally callable by anyone and loops over caller supplied symbols posting prices.
postPriceInternal resolves the symbol config through getTokenConfigBySymbol.
postPriceInternal dispatches REPORTER_ETH configs to fetchAnchorPriceETH.
postPriceInternal dispatches REPORTER_USD configs to fetchAnchorPriceUSD.
postPriceInternal writes prices[symbolHash] = anchorPrice with no owner/role restriction.
refresh() is a permissionless state-changing oracle write path into prices.
price() resolves the TokenConfig via getTokenConfigBySymbol.
price() delegates the actual price selection to priceInternal.
priceInternal returns the stored prices[symbolHash] value for reporter based configs.
getUnderlyingPrice resolves the config via getTokenConfigByCToken.
getUnderlyingPrice reads the base price from priceInternal.
getUnderlyingPrice scales the price with mul(1e30, priceInternal(config)).
fetchEthPrice delegates to fetchAnchorPriceUSD('ETH', ...).
fetchEthPrice looks up the ETH config using getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(ethHash).
fetchAnchorPriceETH obtains window accumulators from pokeWindowValues.
fetchAnchorPriceETH decodes the TWAP with decode112with18.
fetchAnchorPriceETH scales the raw price using mul().
fetchAnchorPriceETH indirectly refreshes the TWAP through pokeWindowValues/currentCumulativePrice.
fetchAnchorPriceETH derives timeElapsed and the require guard directly from block.timestamp.
timeElapsed = block.timestamp - oldTimestamp feeds the TWAP divisor.
priceAverage is truncated through uint224 inside fetchAnchorPriceETH.
(nowCumulativePrice - oldCumulativePrice) / timeElapsed is divided without a zero/guard on the manipulated accumulator delta.
fetchAnchorPriceUSD obtains window accumulators from pokeWindowValues.
fetchAnchorPriceUSD scales the price using mul().
fetchAnchorPriceUSD depends on block.timestamp for its elapsed time checks.
anchorPrice in fetchAnchorPriceUSD is computed by unscaledPriceMantissa / expScale.
pokeWindowValues reads the current cumulative price via currentCumulativePrice.
pokeWindowValues compares block.timestamp - newObservation.timestamp against anchorPeriod.
pokeWindowValues rotates state into oldObservations.
pokeWindowValues updates newObservations with the fresh accumulator.
anchorPeriod gates whether the observation windows are rolled.
timeElapsed window comparison uses an unchecked successor timestamp.
currentCumulativePrice calls UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices.
currentCumulativePrices calls currentBlockTimestamp().
currentCumulativePrices staticcalls the untrusted pair's price0CumulativeLast/price1CumulativeLast.
currentCumulativePrices staticcalls the untrusted pair's getReserves for the counterfactual delta.
currentCumulativePrices compares blockTimestampLast against the block.timestamp derived blockTimestamp.
price0Cumulative/price1Cumulative += fraction(...) * timeElapsed relies on intended wrapping arithmetic.
timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast relies on desired uint32 underflow.
blockTimestampLast is consumed from the untrusted pair reserves.
currentBlockTimestamp truncates block.timestamp to uint32.
FixedPoint.fraction performs (uint224(numerator) << 112) / denominator on unchecked values.
fraction divides by the denominator after requiring it to be non-zero.
mul performs a raw a * b before the manual overflow require.
source() forwards the computed hash and signature parts to ecrecover.
source() abi.decodes the raw caller supplied signature bytes.
source() builds the Ethereum signed message prefix hash for recovery.
getTokenConfigByCToken looks the gToken up with getCTokenIndex.
getTokenConfigByCToken returns getTokenConfig(index) on a hit.
getTokenConfigByCToken falls back to getTokenConfigByUnderlying on a miss.
getTokenConfigByCToken makes an external call to an arbitrary caller supplied gToken contract (CErc20(gToken).underlying()).
getCTokenIndex compares the input against the stored gToken00..gToken19 immutables.
getCTokenIndex returns uint(-1) as a not-found sentinel instead of reverting.
getUnderlyingIndex compares the input against the stored underlying00..underlying19 immutables.
getUnderlyingIndex returns uint(-1) as a not-found sentinel.

getSymbolHashIndex returns uint(-1) as a not-found sentinel.

getTokenConfigBySymbolHash forwards to getTokenConfig.

getTokenConfigByUnderlying resolves the index via getUnderlyingIndex.
getTokenConfigByUnderlying forwards to getTokenConfig.
